other.label: Pathology requires a different lymphoma pathway.

nlphl_primary.label: NLPHL primary treatment: stage/bulk/symptom-directed observation, ISRT, anti-CD20 therapy and/or systemic therapy.

recommendation.title: NLPHL primary treatment: stage/bulk/symptom-directed observation, ISRT, anti-CD20 therapy and/or systemic therapy.

options.label: Stage-directed treatment
options.text: Use separate IA/IIA, bulky/B-symptom, noncontiguous and III-IV branches.

options.label: Observation
options.text: Only for source-defined completely excised solitary Stage IA situations.

nlphl_rr.label: Refractory/suspected relapsed NLPHL: biopsy confirmation when appropriate, then anti-CD20/systemic/RT/HDT-ASCR options based on transformation, symptoms, prior treatment and transplant status.

recommendation.title: Refractory/suspected relapsed NLPHL: biopsy confirmation when appropriate, then anti-CD20/systemic/RT/HDT-ASCR options based on transformation, symptoms, prior treatment and transplant status.

options.label: Biopsy and salvage
options.text: Confirm suspected relapse/transformation where appropriate, then use source-directed salvage.

options.label: Observation
options.text: May be appropriate for selected asymptomatic source-defined states.

rr13.label: Primary refractory CHL / relapse within 3 months and transplant candidate: second-line systemic therapy → response assessment → HDT/ASCR, with post-transplant maintenance only when source high-risk criteria and exposure prerequisites are met.

recommendation.title: Primary refractory CHL / relapse within 3 months and transplant candidate: second-line systemic therapy → response assessment → HDT/ASCR, with post-transplant maintenance only when source high-risk criteria and exposure prerequisites are met.

options.label: Second-line therapy
options.text: CPI-based or other source-listed salvage according to prior exposure.

options.label: HDT/ASCR
options.text: Proceed after adequate response when eligible.

options.label: Maintenance
options.text: Only when source post-ASCR high-risk criteria and no disqualifying prior exposure are satisfied.

rr14.label: Biopsy-proven CHL relapse ≥3 months and transplant candidate: second-line therapy (CPI-based preferred when no prior CPI) → response assessment → HDT/ASCR, with maintenance when indicated.

recommendation.title: Biopsy-proven CHL relapse ≥3 months and transplant candidate: second-line therapy (CPI-based preferred when no prior CPI) → response assessment → HDT/ASCR, with maintenance when indicated.

options.label: Second-line systemic therapy
options.text: Prefer CPI-based salvage when source prior-exposure condition is met.

options.label: HDT/ASCR
options.text: Proceed after response if eligible.

rr15.label: Relapsed/refractory CHL not a candidate for HDT/ASCR: source-directed systemic therapy, RT, clinical trial, or observation in selected contexts based on prior exposures and symptoms.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory CHL not a candidate for HDT/ASCR: source-directed systemic therapy, RT, clinical trial, or observation in selected contexts based on prior exposures and symptoms.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Checkpoint inhibitor/BV/other source options based on prior exposure.

options.label: RT/observation
options.text: Selected local/asymptomatic settings.

post_bx_neg.label: Residual PET concern with negative biopsy: observe/short-interval reassessment or source-directed local management rather than automatically treating as refractory disease.

recommendation.title: Residual PET concern with negative biopsy: observe/short-interval reassessment or source-directed local management rather than automatically treating as refractory disease.

options.label: Observation/reassessment
options.text: Use source response follow-up; do not assume active lymphoma from PET alone.

follow.label: Hodgkin lymphoma follow-up and late-effects monitoring.

recommendation.title: Hodgkin lymphoma follow-up and late-effects monitoring.

options.label: Clinical/lab follow-up
options.text: Use source schedule through 5 years and beyond.

options.label: Late effects
options.text: Thyroid, cardiovascular, second malignancy, fertility and other treatment-specific monitoring.

interim_adjust.label: Interim PET Deauville 4-5 without biopsy-proven refractory disease: use stage/regimen-specific response-adapted continuation/escalation/RT pathway rather than automatic relapse therapy.

recommendation.title: Interim PET Deauville 4-5 without biopsy-proven refractory disease: use stage/regimen-specific response-adapted continuation/escalation/RT pathway rather than automatic relapse therapy.

options.label: Response-adapted therapy
options.text: Apply the regimen/stage-specific PET-adapted branch and biopsy requirements.

interim_good.label: Interim PET Deauville 1-3: continue/de-escalate/add RT according to the exact initial stage/risk/regimen pathway.

recommendation.title: Interim PET Deauville 1-3: continue/de-escalate/add RT according to the exact initial stage/risk/regimen pathway.

options.label: Continue response-adapted frontline plan
options.text: Use initial risk/regimen-specific Deauville branch.

preg_action.label: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma during pregnancy: trimester/severity-directed observation or therapy with pregnancy-specific imaging and treatment constraints.

recommendation.title: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma during pregnancy: trimester/severity-directed observation or therapy with pregnancy-specific imaging and treatment constraints.

options.label: Pregnancy-adapted management
options.text: Use source trimester, symptoms/organ compromise, and fetal considerations; refer to expert center.

older.label: Age >60 or unfit for intensive therapy?

older_action.label: CHL age >60/unfit: age/fitness-adapted systemic therapy and PET response pathway.

recommendation.title: CHL age >60/unfit: age/fitness-adapted systemic therapy and PET response pathway.

options.label: Age/fitness-adapted therapy
options.text: Use source regimen set based on anthracycline candidacy and stage.

adv.label: Stage III-IV CHL: frontline systemic therapy with regimen-specific interim/end PET adaptation.

recommendation.title: Stage III-IV CHL: frontline systemic therapy with regimen-specific interim/end PET adaptation.

options.label: Frontline systemic therapy
options.text: Use source preferred regimen(s), age/comorbidity and toxicity considerations.

options.label: PET-adapted management
options.text: Apply HODG-7A-D based on regimen and Deauville response.

early_fav_action.label: Stage I-II favorable CHL: GHSG/EORTC-specific limited therapy with PET-adapted RT/chemotherapy decisions.

recommendation.title: Stage I-II favorable CHL: GHSG/EORTC-specific limited therapy with PET-adapted RT/chemotherapy decisions.

options.label: Combined modality/PET-adapted therapy
options.text: Use GHSG vs EORTC source branch and Deauville response.

options.label: Deauville 4-5 branch
options.text: Use HODG-5B when applicable.

early_unfav.label: Stage I-II unfavorable CHL: risk/bulk/B-symptom-directed systemic therapy with interim PET adaptation ± ISRT.

recommendation.title: Stage I-II unfavorable CHL: risk/bulk/B-symptom-directed systemic therapy with interim PET adaptation ± ISRT.

options.label: Systemic therapy + PET adaptation
options.text: Use source unfavorable-stage regimen and response branches.

options.label: ISRT
options.text: Use when source branch indicates based on bulk/response.

outside.label: Case is outside Hodgkin lymphoma ruleset.
